_doc: c06 (critic A #2): per-pitch level trims in dB for notes on a legato articulation, {track: {midi pitch: dB}}: sample unevenness by pitch measured at a flat CC11 (Horn 1 F4 +5.0 / Gb4 -5.3 / Ab4 -4.8 dB residual; Cl1 G5 +9.9 / Ab5 -4.6; CA A4 +9.1; Fl1 Gb5 -2.9 with its +10 CC1). Applied in vol_db from 0.1 qn before the score onset with a 0.25 qn ramp, held to the note end. c07: a track entry may carry "_all_arts": true to apply its trims to every articulation (Sus chords too), not only legato notes (B #1, #4, #5): Horns 1-4 F4 -5 / Gb4 +4 / Ab4 +3, Double basses Ab1 -5, Bassoon 2 Db3 -5. c08: a value may be {"early": dB, "body": dB} (early to onset + 0.35 s, then body by + 0.6 s; Horns F4 +1/-5, A #1). "_arts": [names] applies a track's trims only to those articulations (plus legato) (Violas/Vc pizz., A #3). "_all_arts_pitches": [pitches] trims those pitches on every articulation (Flute 1 G6-Bb6, B #1). Notes longer than 4 qn are trimmed only to onset + 3 qn (Cb Ab1 coda pedals, B #5). c15 (B #3): Flute 1 Bb4 +4, C5 +3, Db5 +3 (theme B low notes 4-6 dB under the F5 on the same CC). c16 (B #5): Bassoon 2 `_skip_onsets` [268]: the Eb3 +6 (measured at soft levels) plus the end of roles [262,268,4] put +8.6 dB on the held Eb3 at the start of the bar 81 decrescendo, level with the tune. v600 port (c27): pitch keys kept; _skip_onsets removed where the note changed: Clarinet 1 204, Bassoon 2 198.
